name: Talheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Talheim (a green fir above a red cow on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Talheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Talheim arms — fir and cow on yellow
